newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Jan-Nov trade deficit falls 15.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Jan-Nov trade deficit falls 15.3 pct.

text.p: Sri Lanka's trade balance fell 15.3 percent or $227 million for the January-November 1996 period compared to a year ago, the Central Bank said on Friday.
It recorded a trade deficit of $1,262 million for the 11 months, down from $1.49 billion a year ago, the bank said in a report.
Exports were up 8.5 percent during the period to $3,662 million from $3,376 million while imports were also up to $4,924 million from $4,867 million.
